_doc: Declarative backend role binding for OT SPI_DEVICE. irq + pin_io reproduce the auto-detector byte-for-byte (irq from bindings/spi_device.digest.json irq_suggestion; pin_io = the cio_sd_o/cio_sd_en_o/cio_sd_i triple the detector reports). `clocks` is the new third clock verdict: cio_csb_i (chip select) and cio_sck_i (SPI serial clock) are EVENT clocks whose edges carry information; clk_i is the primary (bus) clock and stays beat. aux_pin_groups exports the raw SPI pins as named qdev lines (sck-in/csb-in/sd-in[4]/sd-out[4]) so an in-machine SSI bridge can drive the device from a generated spi_host — the SPI self-loop group.

spi_slave._doc: SPI slave transport for the QP shim: QEMU delivers bytes + chip-select (lowRISC spidev '/CS' framing on a chardev); the shim expands each byte into 8 sck edges on the declared pins (mode 0, MSB first) and samples MISO. sck/csb must be declared event clocks above.
